# API reference

<!-- Generated by `npm run docs:api` from the Zod schemas registered on each route. Do not edit by hand. -->

All endpoints are JSON except the two Google sign-in redirects. Visitors start anonymous: the first request gets a signed, HTTP-only `theshire_learner` cookie. Signing in with Google adds a `theshire_session` cookie; progress then belongs to the account, and anything done anonymously in that browser is merged in. Every response carries an `X-Request-Id` header (an incoming one is kept).

Errors share one shape:

```ts
{ error: { code: string; message: string } }
```

| Code | Meaning |
| ---- | ------- |
| `VALIDATION_ERROR` | 400. The request body or params failed schema validation. |
| `NOT_FOUND` | 404. No such route. |
| `COURSE_NOT_FOUND` | 404. Unknown course slug. |
| `LESSON_NOT_FOUND` | 404. Unknown lesson id. |
| `EXERCISE_NOT_FOUND` | 404. Unknown exercise id. |
| `AUTH_NOT_CONFIGURED` | 404. Google sign-in is not set up on this server. |
| `EXERCISES_INCOMPLETE` | 409. The lesson's exercises have not all passed yet. |
| `RATE_LIMITED` | 429. Too many run/submit requests from this learner or IP. See `Retry-After`. |
| `SANDBOX_BUSY` | 429. Every sandbox slot and queue position is taken. Retry shortly. |
| `SANDBOX_UNAVAILABLE` | 503. Docker or the runner images are unavailable. |
| `INTERNAL_ERROR` | 500. Unexpected failure; details are only in the server log. |

## `GET /api/health`

Liveness check. Always 200 while the API is up; `docker.available` reports whether code can run.

**200 response**

```ts
{
  status: "ok";
  uptimeSeconds: number;
  docker: {
    available: boolean;
    version?: string;
  };
}
```

## `POST /api/run`

Run code once in a fresh sandbox container. Rate limited per learner and per IP.

**Request body**

```ts
{
  language: "python" | "javascript";
  code: string; // max 65536 chars
}
```

**200 response**

```ts
{
  stdout: string;
  stderr: string;
  exitCode: number | null;
  timedOut: boolean;
  oomKilled: boolean;
  truncated: boolean;
  durationMs: number;
}
```

**429 response**

```ts
{
  error: {
    code: string;
    message: string;
  };
}
```

**503 response**

```ts
{
  error: {
    code: string;
    message: string;
  };
}
```

## `GET /api/courses`

List all courses in catalog order.

**200 response**

```ts
{
  courses: {
    slug: string;
    title: string;
    description: string;
    language: "python" | "javascript";
    lessonCount: number;
    exerciseCount: number;
  }[];
}
```

## `GET /api/courses/:slug`

A course with its lessons in order.

**Path params**

```ts
{
  slug: string;
}
```

**200 response**

```ts
{
  slug: string;
  title: string;
  description: string;
  language: "python" | "javascript";
  lessonCount: number;
  exerciseCount: number;
  lessons: {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    order: number;
    exerciseIds: string[];
  }[];
}
```

**404 response**

```ts
{
  error: {
    code: string;
    message: string;
  };
}
```

## `GET /api/lessons/:id`

A lesson as structured blocks. Hidden tests carry no call or expected output, and solutions are never included.

**Path params**

```ts
{
  id: string;
}
```

**200 response**

```ts
{
  id: string;
  title: string;
  order: number;
  course: {
    slug: string;
    title: string;
    language: "python" | "javascript";
  };
  position: number;
  lessonCount: number;
  prevLessonId: string | null;
  nextLessonId: string | null;
  blocks: {
    type: "markdown";
    markdown: string;
  }
  | {
    type: "runnable";
    id: string;
    language: "python" | "javascript";
    code: string;
  }
  | {
    type: "exercise";
    id: string;
    language: "python" | "javascript";
    starterCode: string;
    hint: string | null;
    tests: {
      id: string;
      hidden: false;
      call: string;
      expect: string;
    }
    | {
      id: string;
      hidden: true;
    }[];
  }[];
}
```

**404 response**

```ts
{
  error: {
    code: string;
    message: string;
  };
}
```

## `POST /api/exercises/:id/submit`

Grade code against the exercise's tests, each in its own sandbox. Records the attempt; completes the lesson once all its exercises pass. Rate limited.

**Path params**

```ts
{
  id: string;
}
```

**Request body**

```ts
{
  code: string; // max 65536 chars
}
```

**200 response**

```ts
{
  exerciseId: string;
  passed: boolean;
  passedCount: number;
  totalCount: number;
  tests: {
    id: string;
    hidden: false;
    status: "passed" | "wrong_output" | "error" | "timeout" | "memory_limit" | "output_limit";
    passed: boolean;
    exact: boolean;
    call: string;
    expect: string;
    stdout: string;
    stderr: string;
    durationMs: number;
  }
  | {
    id: string;
    hidden: true;
    status: "passed" | "wrong_output" | "error" | "timeout" | "memory_limit" | "output_limit";
    passed: boolean;
  }[];
  lessonCompleted: boolean;
}
```

**404 response**

```ts
{
  error: {
    code: string;
    message: string;
  };
}
```

**429 response**

```ts
{
  error: {
    code: string;
    message: string;
  };
}
```

**503 response**

```ts
{
  error: {
    code: string;
    message: string;
  };
}
```

## `GET /api/progress`

The current learner's completed lessons and exercise attempts.

**200 response**

```ts
{
  completedLessons: {
    lessonId: string;
    completedAt: string;
  }[];
  exercises: {
    exerciseId: string;
    attempts: number;
    passedAt: string | null;
  }[];
}
```

## `PUT /api/progress/:lessonId`

Mark a lesson complete. Idempotent. 409 if the lesson has exercises that have not all passed.

**Path params**

```ts
{
  lessonId: string;
}
```

**200 response**

```ts
{
  completedLessons: {
    lessonId: string;
    completedAt: string;
  }[];
  exercises: {
    exerciseId: string;
    attempts: number;
    passedAt: string | null;
  }[];
}
```

**404 response**

```ts
{
  error: {
    code: string;
    message: string;
  };
}
```

**409 response**

```ts
{
  error: {
    code: string;
    message: string;
  };
}
```

## `GET /api/auth/me`

Who is signed in, and whether Google sign-in is available.

**200 response**

```ts
{
  user: {
    name: string | null;
    email: string | null;
    avatarUrl: string | null;
  }
  | null;
  googleEnabled: boolean;
}
```

## `GET /api/auth/google/login`

Starts "Sign in with Google": redirects to Google, then back to `returnTo` (a same-site path). 404 if not configured.

**404 response**

```ts
{
  error: {
    code: string;
    message: string;
  };
}
```

## `GET /api/auth/google/callback`

Google redirects here. Verifies the response, signs the learner in, and redirects back.

**404 response**

```ts
{
  error: {
    code: string;
    message: string;
  };
}
```

## `POST /api/auth/logout`

Signs out. The browser continues as a fresh anonymous learner.

**200 response**

```ts
{
  user: {
    name: string | null;
    email: string | null;
    avatarUrl: string | null;
  }
  | null;
  googleEnabled: boolean;
}
```
